……ふぅ。今日の探索の成果はそこそこといったところか。\n鑑も不知火の操縦にずい:
...Whew. Today's exploration went reasonably well.
Kagami seems to have grown quite used to piloting the Shiranui.
うん！ みんながサポートしてくれたおかげだよ！\nメイズがホント迷路なのはぜんぜ:
Yeah! Thanks to everyone's support!
I'm still not used to the Maze being an actual maze, though...
そうですね、最初は本当に大変でした……: Yes. It was really difficult at first...
坑道が入り組んでて、メイズシフターもいて、\n帰ってくるだけでも一苦労でしたから:
The tunnels were so tangled, and there were Maze Shifters, too.
Even getting back was a struggle...
うむ……衛士として戦ってきた経験は残っているが、\nそれだけでは対処が難しいから:
Indeed... We still remember fighting as Surface Pilots,
but that experience alone is not enough to handle this...
だが、それでもゆっくりと前進していけばよい。\nそれが結果的には我々と学園の両方:
Still, we need only make steady progress.
In the end, that should benefit both us and the academy.
うん、そうだね。色々親切にしてもらったし、\n早くみんなの役に立てるようになりた:
Yeah, you're right. Everyone's been so kind to us.
I want to be able to help them soon.
ああ。だが、焦りは禁物だぞ。: Yes. But we must not rush.
そうですね。今日も、ちょっと危ない場面がありましたし。: That's true. We had a slightly dangerous moment today, too.
しっかりと記憶もないのも大変だよねぇ。\n私なんてシミュレーターで、最初から勉強:
It's hard when your memories aren't clear, either.
I'm exhausted just starting from scratch in the simulator...
ふふ、一つ一つ着実に学んでいくしかなかろう。\n鑑の成長は目を見張るものがあるぞ:
Hehe. We can only learn steadily, one step at a time.
Your progress has been remarkable, Kagami.
えへへ、そうかな？ よーし、頑張るぞー！: Ehehe. You think so? All right! I'll keep at it!
……あれ、わたし達の他にも\nちょうど地上に上がってきた人がいるみたい。:
...Oh, it looks like someone else
has just come back to the surface, too.
一機だけか？ ……妙だな。\nメイズに潜るにはチームを組むことが必須のはず。:
Only one machine? ...Strange.
We are supposed to form a team before entering the Maze.
そういえば榊野さんってたった一人だけで、\nチームとして認められたんだっけ！:
Oh, right! Sakakino-san was recognized
as a whole team all by herself, wasn't she?!
うん、そう。私についてこれる人がいなかったし、\n面倒だったから生徒会長に言った:
Yes. No one could keep up with me,
and it was a hassle. I told the Student Council President, and it was approved.
ほう……あの苛烈なメイズ内を単機で探索できるとは、\n見事な才能だな。:
Impressive... To explore that unforgiving Maze alone
takes considerable talent.
……ん？ どうした？ 何を見ているんだ？: ...Hm? What is it? What are you looking at?
……そっちじゃない。\nそのピッタリとしてる服……気になる。:
...Not that.
Those close-fitting clothes... I'm curious.
ああ、衛士強化装備のことか。: Ah, you mean the Surface Pilot's Fortified Suit.
……やっぱり気になるよねえ。\nかなり体のラインが出ちゃって、際どいもんね……:
...Yeah, I can see why you'd be curious.
It really shows your figure. It's pretty revealing...
わたしはあんまり慣れた感じが無くて、\nまわりに人がいるとちょっと気になっちゃう:
I'm still not very used to it.
I get a little self-conscious with other people around...
一応、そういう羞恥心に耐える訓練も兼ねてるんですけどね。: It does double as training to handle that embarrassment, though.
でも、機能は凄いですし……\nなんだかんだ、着慣れると安心感があるんですよね。:
But its functions are amazing...
And once you get used to wearing it, it feels reassuring.
どういった部分が気になったのだ？\n我々としてはそちらの制服も興味はあるが……:
What in particular caught your interest?
We are curious about your uniforms, too...
衛士強化装備？ っていうの、この素材は何？: A Surface Pilot's Fortified Suit? What's this material?
ああ、特殊保護被膜といって、普段は柔らかいが、\n瞬間的な圧力が加わると硬化して:
It's called a special protective membrane. It is normally soft,
but sudden pressure makes it harden to protect you from impacts.
全身の筋電圧の変化と脳波を照合して数値化、\n戦術機の操縦を補助する役割も持って:
It compares changes in electrical signals from your muscles with your brainwaves,
then converts them into data to help you control a Tactical Surface Fighter.
なるほど……思った以上に高性能。: I see... More advanced than I expected.
ああ。着用している時にデータも計測されている。\nだから肉体の状態もある程度は管:
Yes. It also takes measurements while you wear it.
That lets it keep track of your physical condition to some extent.
戦術機に乗っている時であれば、\n機体の電力で充電して長時間の稼働にも耐えうる。:
While you are in a Tactical Surface Fighter,
it can use the machine's power to recharge and keep running for long periods.
つまり、そっちの乗ってる……戦術機？ と紐づいている？: So it's linked to the machine you pilot... A Tactical Surface Fighter?
ああ、そういう認識で問題はない。\n衛士としての戦闘をフォローしてくれる装備だ。:
Yes, that is a fair way to understand it.
It is equipment that supports us in combat as Surface Pilots.
飲料水パックも内蔵している。\n長時間の戦闘で脱水状態になった場合の対策もされて:
It also has a built-in drinking-water pack.
A precaution against dehydration during prolonged combat.
興味深い……サバイバルでも水の確保は重要。\n確かにそういう機能は欲しい。:
Interesting... Securing water matters for survival, too.
I'd certainly like that feature.
むしろ、我々としてはそちらの装備も興味があるがな。\n普段着のような見た目で高機:
We are curious about your equipment, as well.
It looks like ordinary clothing, yet performs so well.
あまり自覚はなかったけど、確かにそう。: I hadn't thought much about it, but yes.
――ヒイロさん、御剣さんの強化装備をすっごく見てますね。\nやっぱり珍しい装備だ:
...Hiiro-san is really studying Mitsurugi-san's Fortified Suit.
I suppose she's interested because it's so unusual?
……うーん、榊野さんに他意はないんだろうけど、\nあんな風に体のラインをマジマジ:
...Hmm. I'm sure Sakakino-san doesn't mean anything by it,
but when I think about her staring at our figures like that...
やっぱり気になってきちゃうかも……\nうう、けっこう露出あるし……:
I might start to feel self-conscious, too...
Aww, it is pretty revealing...
珠瀬さんは、気になったりしない？\n女の子相手でもちょっと恥ずかしいかも……:
Does it bother you, Tamase-san?
It might be a little embarrassing even with another girl...
改めて言われるとちょっと気になってきますね。\n特にこの世界の学園の人たちは普通:
Now that you mention it, I'm starting to notice it, too.
Especially since the students in this world just wear ordinary uniforms...
そうそう！ あの制服、可愛くて羨ましいよね！\nわたしもあんな風な可愛い制服を着:
Exactly! Those uniforms are so cute. I'm jealous!
I'd love to wear a cute uniform like that, too...
分かります。わたし達の服とか装備って、\nああいう可愛い制服と違って軍装の機能性:
I know what you mean. Our clothes and equipment
are designed for military practicality, rather than looking cute like those uniforms.
んー、ならせめてオシャレ用の服を買ってみようかな。\nこの前、すごく素敵な服を売:
Hmm... Then maybe I'll at least buy some nice clothes.
I found a shop with some really lovely outfits the other day!
折角だし、今度のお休みに一緒に買い物に行かない？: Why don't we go shopping together on our next day off?
いいんですか？ なら、一緒に行きましょう！\n一緒にお買い物、楽しみですっ♪:
Really? Then let's go together!
I'm looking forward to shopping with you♪
折角なら、こっちの学園で知り合った子も、\n誘っちゃうってのはどうかな？:
While we're at it, why don't we invite
some of the girls we've met at this academy, too?
それなら、めるちゃんにも連絡とってみよっと♪\n……そういえば、御剣さん達も盛り:
Then I'll get in touch with Meru-chan♪
...Oh, Mitsurugi-san and the others are having quite a conversation, too.
――とうわけだな。\nこの刀自体は強化装備の一部ではないが大切なものだ。:
...And that is the story.
The sword itself is not part of the Fortified Suit, but it is important to me.
なるほど……私のネイルガンと一緒なんだ。思い入れは重要。: I see... Like my nail gun. That attachment matters.
ああ、その通りだ。\nふふ。この感覚が異郷でも通じるのは嬉しいな。:
Yes, exactly.
Hehe. I'm glad that feeling is understood even in a strange land.
でも、その素材は実際に硬くなるの？\nあんまりイメージが出来ない。:
But does the material really turn hard?
I can't quite picture it.
よかったら実際に触ってみるか？\nこういったものは体感する方が分かりやすいだろう:
Would you like to feel it for yourself?
Something like this is easier to understand firsthand.
いいの？ なら、ぜひ触ってみたい。: Can I? Then I'd really like to.
衝撃から身を守る以外にも、\n防刃仕様、耐熱耐寒、化学物質にも耐えられる。:
Besides protecting against impacts,
it resists blades, heat, cold and chemicals.
そんな風には見えないけど……\nん、柔らかい……本当に？:
It doesn't look like it would...
Mm, it's soft... Really?
今度は力を込めて叩いてみるがよい。: Now try striking it with some force.
なるほど。強く叩いたら硬くなった……！\n不思議な感じ……:
I see. It hardened when I hit it hard...!
What a strange feeling...
おお、強く突いても早く突いても硬くなる……\nでも、ゆっくりやると柔らかい……不:
Oh, a hard poke makes it harden. A quick one, too...
But it's soft if I do it slowly... Strange...
なるほど……これがいざという時に体を守るんだ。: I see... That's how it protects you when you need it.
ああ。他にも機能はあるのだが、この素材は傷口に対して、\nすぐに浸透して止血する:
There are other functions, too. This material can quickly seep into a wound
and stop the bleeding.
そちらの制服も優れているだろうが、\nいざという時の負傷に関してはこちらの装備が:
Your uniforms are excellent as well, I'm sure,
but when it comes to injuries in an emergency, this equipment...
これは……面白い。癖になる。\nさわさわ……:
This is... fun. I could get hooked on it.
Stroke, stroke...
……まぁ、気に入ったのなら好きにするがよい。: ...Well, if you like it, go ahead.
うん、ありがとう。\nお言葉に甘えて……つんつん。:
Yes. Thank you.
I'll take you up on that... Poke, poke.
この被膜は溶解剤で溶かす事ができるのだが、\n万が一に怪我をした場合には――:
The membrane can be dissolved with a solvent,
so if you were ever injured--
ダメ。そんなのはとても勿体ない。\nこの感触がなくなるのは損失:
No. That would be such a waste.
It'd be a shame to lose this feeling.
とても素晴らしい。\n……どうにかして、手に入らない？:
It's wonderful.
...Is there some way I can get some?
そうだな……生徒会長の元で皮膜だけは、\n同等のものを作れる目処が立ったと聞いて:
Well... I hear the Student Council President's people have found a way
to make an equivalent of the membrane itself, but...
なるほど……聞きに行ってくる。\nどうにかして貰いたい。:
I see... I'll go ask.
I'd really like to get some.
……装備としてではなく、\n感触を楽しむ目的になっていないか？:
...You no longer want it as equipment,
but simply to enjoy the feel of it, don't you?
……だって、このぷにぷに感は魅力的。\n出来るならずっと触っていたい。:
...But the squishiness is so appealing.
I'd keep touching it forever if I could.
良い装備を見せてくれてありがとう。: Thank you for showing me such good equipment.
おかげで色々と参考に出来たし……\n冥夜達が、どれだけ大変な環境にいたのかも分か:
You've given me a lot to learn from...
And I understand how harsh the place you all lived in must have been, Meiya.
私達が制服でもいいのは、これで事足りるから。\nそれだけ機能を付けるのは危険な場:
Our uniforms are enough because they're all we need.
You had all those features because you lived somewhere dangerous.
だからあれだけのＭＧを操縦する腕前がある。\nそんな場所で生きてきたあなた達を私:
That's why you're so good at piloting MGs.
I respect all of you for living in a place like that.
だから、またどこかで機会があれば、\n一緒に戦えれば嬉しい。:
So if we get another chance,
I'd be glad to fight alongside you.
きっと、私のまだ知らない、あなた達の強さを知れるから。\nそれじゃあ、待たね。:
I'm sure I'd discover strengths of yours I haven't seen yet.
Well, see you.
……なんだか不思議な人だけど、\nでも……すごくいい子なんだね。:
...She's a little unusual,
but... she's really nice, isn't she?
む？ どうした？\n何か忘れたのか？:
Hm? What is it?
Did you forget something?
……触り収めをしてなかった。\nもうちょっとだけ、感触を楽しみたい。:
...I didn't get one last touch.
I want to enjoy the feeling just a little longer.
ま、待て、ヒイロ！ さっきまで真面目な話を……！\nええい、無言でつつくな！:
W-Wait, Hiiro! We were having a serious conversation...!
Honestly, don't just poke me without a word!
